errors.text_span: 然后下降至JSD权重系数为4时达到最低点（BLEU=24.4）
errors.evidence: This describes the trend incorrectly. The line rises to its peak at a JSD weight coefficient of 4, it does not drop. This point is the highest point (24.7), not the lowest. The lowest point is at the start (23.4).
The description does not mention the color of the line (blue) or the shape of the markers (circles), which were requested in the prompt.
